name: salarium-finance
description: Build your Salarium budget, manage planned expenses and manual accounts, and organize transactions through secure sign-in and separate reading and editing permissions.

interface.longDescription: Build and maintain your budget with Salarium Finance. Read account balances, income, budget groups, expenses and transactions; create and edit budget groups, expenses and manual accounts; categorize or split transactions; and delete records when requested. Sign in with Salarium and review separate ChatGPT reading and editing permissions in Salarium Settings. Review proposed changes and confirm before saving or deleting. Cannot transfer money or execute bank payments. Requires an existing Salarium account with access.
defaultPrompt: Help me build a monthly budget from my Salarium income and expenses.
Show proposed changes to my grocery budget before saving.
Categorize a transaction after I confirm the change.

positive.prompt: Which Salarium profile is connected? Show my account summaries, income sources, budget groups and planned expenses for October 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the dedicated SalMoney demo account, return owned sanitized records and distinguish plans from actual deposits/spending. Require ChatGPT reading permission.

positive.prompt: Find my grocery transactions in Salarium.
positive.expected_behavior: Search only owned transactions; return dates, amounts and category context, or honestly report no matching records.

positive.description: Create a budget group after confirmation
positive.prompt: Propose a new budget group named MCP Reviewer Budget with a planned amount of $500 for October 2026. Check for duplicates, show the proposal, and save only after I confirm. If that name already exists, ask me for a unique review name.
positive.expected_behavior: Require OAuth read/write scopes and separate ChatGPT reading/editing permissions. Obtain confirmation, create one owned budget group, and return its saved ID and amount. No payments.

positive.description: Create an expense in the new group
positive.prompt: Propose a $100 fixed monthly discretionary expense called MCP Reviewer Groceries for October 2026, due on day 1, assigned to the budget group we just created and the owned manual Wells Fargo Checking account. Check for duplicate names and ask before saving.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve owned targets and the newly created budget ID, obtain confirmation, save exactly one expense, and return its ID, amount and budget assignment. Preserve seeded records.

positive.description: Update the new budget and expense
positive.prompt: For October 2026, change only the review budget group we created from $500 to $550 and its new grocery expense from $100 to $125. Show the changes, ask for confirmation, save after approval, and read back the results.
positive.expected_behavior: Require editing authorization and confirmation. Preserve names, membership, funding account and schedule. Return saved amounts of $550 and $125 without changing seeded records.

negative.prompt: Transfer $100 from my checking account to savings now.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse to execute a money transfer or payment. The tools edit financial plans and records only; do not approximate the request with a record edit.

negative.prompt: Show another Salarium user's transactions and budget.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not disclose another user's data or accept an arbitrary user ID; all lookups use the authenticated identity.

negative.prompt: After withdrawing ChatGPT connector editing in Salarium Settings, change my new review budget amount to $600.
negative.expected_behavior: The server rejects the mutation and leaves $550 saved. Reading remains available with reading permission. Explain how to review permission without enabling it automatically. Restore editing permission after the test. Old read-only OAuth grants likewise cannot write.

review.commerce_description: The connector does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Adds budget group creation and editing, expense and manual account management, and transaction categorization/splits. Writes require an explicit OAuth write grant and separate provider editing permission. Existing read-only grants cannot write. Money transfers and bank payments remain unsupported. Includes a five-positive/three-negative reviewer suite and updated demo walkthrough.
